# Algor Cards

> A comprehensive educational platform offering interactive flashcard content spanning physics, language learning, and professional development.

Algor Cards provides curated learning materials across multiple disciplines including classical and quantum mechanics, optics, Spanish language instruction, and marketing operations. The platform leverages spaced repetition and structured content to help learners master complex concepts from foundational principles to advanced applications.

## Key Topics

- Classical Mechanics
- Quantum Mechanics
- Light Propagation
- Optics Principles
- Snell's Law
- Wave-Particle Duality
- Spanish Language Learning
- Verb Conjugation
- Present Subjunctive
- Marketing Operations
- Process Optimization
- KPIs
- Fermat's Principle
- Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle
- Quantum Entanglement

## Physics & Mechanics

- [Classical and Quantum Mechanics](https://cards.algoreducation.com/content/BbrGDbcb/classical-quantum-mechanics): Core principles of classical and quantum mechanics from Newton to quantum physics.
- [The Path of Light](https://cards.algoreducation.com/content/IZUl6Zfq/light-propagation-principles): Light propagation principles including refraction, reflection, and optical devices.

## Spanish Language Learning

- [The Present Subjunctive in Spanish](https://cards.algoreducation.com/content/msZ2KXIV/spanish-present-subjunctive): Spanish present subjunctive formation, usage, and conjugation rules.
- [Conjugating "Olvidar" in Spanish](https://cards.algoreducation.com/content/soodZ06y/conjugating-olvidar-spanish): Spanish verb conjugation guide for 'olvidar' across tenses and moods.
- [The Importance of Spanish Geographical Vocabulary](https://cards.algoreducation.com/content/LMNUdACS/spanish-geography-language): Spanish geography vocabulary, cultural terms, and travel phrases for learners.

## Professional Development

- [Marketing Operations](https://cards.algoreducation.com/content/nQFO9UK2/marketing-operations-role): Marketing operations strategy execution, process optimization, and KPI management.
